# Wild Simcoe Outfitters (working name)

Private, small-group guided outdoor trips based in Barrie, Ontario, on Lake Simcoe — about 70 minutes north of Toronto.

## Trips
- Ice Fishing — private guided days on Lake Simcoe, heated huts, all gear included. Season: mid-January to mid-March.
- Private Ice Fishing Tours — private day on the ice with pickup from Toronto.
- Waterfowl Hunting (Boat & Field) — ducks and geese, layout boats on open water and field hunts over decoys.
- White-Tailed Deer — stand and still hunts on private land.
- Black Bear — spring and fall hunts over established bait sites.
- Backcountry Camping — overnight canoe trips staged from Barrie.
- Survival Training — private, customised skills days.

## Notes
- All trips are private: your group only, never mixed with strangers.
- Hunting trips are for licensed hunters only; licences and eligibility are checked before booking.
- Contact details, prices and policies are being finalised — see https://outfitters-ten.vercel.app for the latest.
